title: ingest-mcp-proxy-ocsf MCP parameters
description: Typed CLI parameters for MCP proxy JSONL to OCSF Application Activity ingestion.

input_path.description: Path to MCP proxy JSONL. Omit to read stdin via the input field.

output_path.description: Write OCSF JSONL to this path instead of stdout.

preserve_mcp_content.description: Opt in to retaining tool inputSchema, sampling systemPrompt, and message text (capped per field) so content detectors can fire. Retained text may contain sensitive data; off by default.
